schools_2year_all.long_description: Postsecondary school accessibility measures how easily residents can reach institutions offering associate degrees or 2-year certificates. Communities with low accessibility scores face barriers to workforce training and career advancement pathways that don't require a four-year degree. This measure uses floating catchment areas to account for both the supply of schools and the population they serve, weighted by travel distance.
schools_2year_all.short_description: 2-year schools per 100k residents over 14, based on 3-step floating catchment area accessibility scores.

schools_2year_min_drivetime.long_description: Drive time to the nearest school authorized to award associate degrees or 2-year certificates. Longer drive times create barriers to postsecondary enrollment, particularly for students who work or have family obligations. This measure captures geographic accessibility independent of school capacity or program offerings.
schools_2year_min_drivetime.provenance: Minimum drive time from Census block group centroids to NCES-listed 2-year postsecondary institutions, calculated using the Open Source Routing Machine. Block group-level times are averaged to produce higher-level geography estimates.
schools_2year_min_drivetime.short_description: Minimum drive time in minutes from block group centroid to the nearest 2-year postsecondary school.

schools_under2year_min_drivetime.long_description: Drive time to the nearest school offering short-term certificates (under 2 years). Short-term programs serve students seeking rapid workforce entry, so geographic proximity is especially important for this population. Longer drive times may discourage enrollment among those with the fewest resources for commuting.
schools_under2year_min_drivetime.provenance: Minimum drive time from Census block group centroids to NCES-listed sub-2-year postsecondary institutions, calculated using the Open Source Routing Machine. Block group-level times are averaged to produce higher-level geography estimates.
schools_under2year_min_drivetime.short_description: Minimum drive time in minutes from block group centroid to the nearest sub-2-year certificate school.

acs_postsecondary_percent.long_description: Postsecondary educational attainment measures the share of residents who have completed any education beyond high school. Higher attainment rates correlate with greater economic mobility, higher household incomes, and better health outcomes. This indicator helps identify communities that may benefit from expanded access to higher education and workforce development programs.
acs_postsecondary_percent.long_name: Estimated Percentage of the Population With Any Postsecondary Education
acs_postsecondary_percent.provenance: Computed from ACS 5-year estimates, table B06009 (Place of Birth by Educational Attainment). Postsecondary education includes anyone reporting education at the associate degree level or higher.
acs_postsecondary_percent.short_description: Percentage of the population with any postsecondary education.

sources.name: U.S. Census, American Community Survey
sources.location: 5-Year estimates, table B06009, via the API

acs_postsecondary_percent.statement: {value} of those in {region_name} report any postsecondary education.

acs_postsecondary_count.long_description: The count of residents who have completed any education beyond high school. This raw count complements the percentage measure by capturing the absolute size of the educated workforce in a community, which is relevant for economic development planning and institutional capacity.
acs_postsecondary_count.long_name: Estimated Number of People With Any Postsecondary Education
acs_postsecondary_count.provenance: Directly tabulated from ACS 5-year estimates, table B06009 (Place of Birth by Educational Attainment). Postsecondary education includes anyone reporting education at the associate degree level or higher.
acs_postsecondary_count.short_description: Number of residents with any postsecondary education.
